title: Fixed Oval Toothed Cup And Separated Ring Display
description: One newly authored complete fixed oval-cup and separated-ring mechanism-style display. A deep thin-wall cup changes continuously from a circular annular rear to an oval mouth with integral blunt outer teeth; its real deep cavity and rear shaft bore are not a solid oval cylinder. A separate complete internally toothed circular annulus stands ahead on two full roots. A smaller complete bored elliptical insert is independently supported further forward, leaving explicit axial separation between all three principal pieces. Whole front and rear shafts, bored bearings, pedestals and one shared ground bed make a single supported exhibit. Unlike the old planetary layout there is no sun/planet set or rear multi-pin carrier; unlike the conical clutch the main cavity is non-axisymmetric with a toothed rim, not a mating pair of cones and a shift fork. No old gear or bearing mesh imported. Three opaque PBR appearances, metres Z-up and full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One complete model zero scenes. Fixed illustrative separated shapes only, not a working strain-wave reducer or engineering design. No elastic deformation, tooth conjugacy, meshing, motion solution, speed ratio, torque, running fit, bearing performance, lubrication, manufacturing, assembly instructions or safety capability. No rigging animation interaction made.
